title: Uydu Yörünge Rejimleri, Takımuydular ve LEO Optik Gözlem Sistemleri
desc: A technical overview of orbital regimes (LEO, MEO, GEO, SSO, Molniya, Lagrange points), mega-constellation architectures (Walker geometries, optical ISLs), and ground-based optical tracking pipelines for LEO objects based on JAXA's multi-station observation models.

title: Zernike Polinomlarının Matematiksel Altyapısı ve Optik Uygulamaları
desc: A self-contained derivation of Zernike polynomials, covering orthogonality on the unit disk, Noll/OSA/Fringe indexing conventions, Seidel aberrations, and their role in wavefront reconstruction for adaptive optics.
